name: Convoke
description: Convoke gives your agents access to an up-to-date biopharma intelligence database, a structured knowledge graph spanning drug development programs and their catalysts. Catalysts include upcoming clinical trial milestones and regulatory or commercial events. Search programs by drug, target or disease name and resolve to canonical identifiers.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Convoke to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Convoke to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.convoke.bio/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Convoke MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Convoke provides these MCP tools: query_program_tracker and query_catalyst_calendar.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Convoke?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Convoke in health-life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include Groupon, SNOMED CT Terminology, Rhizome AI - FDA & HA Regulatory Research, Aiva, and Amass Connector.
Convoke requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Convoke is developed by Convoke Holdings, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
